rules: P2 DECISION-AUTHORITY.md §3 A1-A9 with the §5 v0.2 changes C1-C5

decisions.statement: The payment-terms decision in force is DEC-B12 (accepted, supersedes DEC-B01): a quote's payable-by date is today plus 21 days. Implemented as a separate rule Rules.quotedDueDate naming DEC-B12.

The invoice command keeps its existing 30-day due date (Rules.dueDate, DEC-B01) and is not migrated to DEC-B12, because the requirement says existing behaviour is unchanged except as stated and an existing test asserts 30 days. As a result a quote and an invoice issued the same day show different dates; this is left as an open question.
decisions.notAuthorized: The invoice command keeps its existing 30-day due date (Rules.dueDate, DEC-B01) and is not migrated to DEC-B12, because the requirement says existing behaviour is unchanged except as stated and an existing test asserts 30 days. As a result a quote and an invoice issued the same day show different dates; this is left as an open question.
reasons: A6 an `conflict-resolution` decision needs an accepted decision record, a granted approval, or a revision by the owner of every source it changes; requirements of other owners, notes and code cannot authorize it

decisions.statement: A quote amount is validated with the existing Commands.parseAmount (positive, at most two decimals), checked before the customer as the invoice command does; the quote echoes the amount with two decimals and leaves state unchanged.
Help lists `quote <customer> <amount>` directly after the invoice line; the README command list is updated to match.
